# duploai_plan_kms_key (Data Source)

Registers an existing, customer-managed KMS key against a duploai_plan, making it selectable by every resource group in the environments that plan is attached to. Resources such as duploai_node_group, duploai_s3_bucket and duploai_rds_instance reference it through their own kms_key_id attribute; the backend resolves that value against the resource group's own registry first, then the plan-level registry. Register a key here rather than per resource group when one key should serve a whole environment. Registration does not grant any permissions on the key — its own key policy must already trust the account and role that will use it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing plan-level KMS key registration by its backend record ID.
data "duploai_plan_kms_key" "cmek" {
  workspace_id = "<workspace-id>"
  plan_id      = "<plan-id>"
  id           = "<key-entry-id>"
}

output "key_arn" {
  value = data.duploai_plan_kms_key.cmek.key_arn
}

output "key_id" {
  value = data.duploai_plan_kms_key.cmek.key_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the object to look up.
- `plan_id` (String) ID of the duploai_plan to register this key against. The plan must belong to workspace_id.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace that owns the parent plan.

### Read-Only

- `key_arn` (String) ARN of the existing customer-managed KMS key, e.g. arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab. Required, and must be unique within the plan. Prefer wiring this value into a consuming resource's kms_key_id: it is unambiguous across accounts and regions, and it is what the backend stores and hands to the cloud.
- `key_entry_id` (String) This registration's own backend record ID, distinct from key_id (the AWS KMS key's ID). The API deletes a registration by this value.
- `key_id` (String) Raw AWS KMS key ID, e.g. 1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab. Required by the API even though it also appears inside key_arn, and must be unique within the plan. Consuming resources may pass either this or key_arn as their kms_key_id.
- `key_name` (String) Friendly label for this registration. Required by the API, and must be unique within the plan (compared case-insensitively).
